_comment: DRAFT v0.1 — D-02 proposal. Served verbatim from artifacts; every number traceable to run_id. Unfavorable results are reported as-is.
method_form: log1p(S_modis) = a + b*log1p(S_viirs) + c*log1p(1+n_viirs) + d*I_night; S_hat = k*expm1(y_hat), k = Duan smearing (training residuals)

metric_caveats.na_policy: N/A:<reason>, never infinity, never fabricated zero

limitations: Harmonized values are model estimates — not ground truth; every value ships with its interval.
Detections are never summed into a fire count across sensors.
Aqua-reference calibration limits claims to what it supports; Terra claims forbidden.
Gaps are flagged, never interpolated. Failed retrieval is not zero.
citations: NASA FIRMS — MODIS C6.1 (Giglio et al. 2016); VIIRS 375 m VNP14IMG (Schroeder et al. 2014).
